lines.text: The LORD stirred Cyrus king of Persia to proclaim that God's people should go to Jerusalem and build His house.
Family heads of Judah and Benjamin, priests, and Levites prepared to go, and neighbors gave them silver and gold.
Cyrus brought out the articles Nebuchadnezzar had carried away, and Mithredath counted them out to Daniel the prince of Judah.
Priests who found no family records were excluded from the priesthood and told not to eat the most holy things.
Some family heads gave freewill offerings, including 61,000 darics of gold and 5,000 minas of bronze.
